description: A task to help preschool students recognize and name basic colors.

engage.speech_start: Wow, look at all these pretty colors! Do you have a favorite color?
engage.speech_end: Let's learn some new colors together.
engage.description: Playing a colorful rainbow animation video.

explore.speech_start: Can you point to something blue in the room?
explore.description: Kinesthetic activity identifying physical colors in the classroom.
explore.activity_description: Look around and point to any object that matches the teacher's color.

explain.speech_start: This is red, this is blue, and this is yellow. They are so bright!
explain.description: Robot visually shows primary colors and names them.

elaborate.speech_start: Let's see if we can find the right color.

evaluate.speech_start: Okay, it's your turn to pick the color all by yourself.
evaluate.task_description: Which object is the red car?
